messages:
maria (Marketing): Quick thread to hammer out the benchmark narrative we want for next week's push. Goal: an engineer-facing latency vs cost story that maps to product decisions.
jon (Product): Topline requirements: (a) transparent configs, (b) p50/p95/p99 plots, (c) cost per 1k tokens across common seq lengths, (d) a one-line CTA for trial.
kevin (Eng): Data-wise we should do two canonical workloads: conversational chat (~512 tokens avg) and short completions (~128 tokens). Hardware: A100-80GB. Run q4_0 and fp16 to show tradeoffs.
amy (Content): For messaging, two headline options: "Interactive latency, sensible pricing" and "Same output quality, half the cost". Need to keep claims conservative.
sam (Data): Kickstarted a sweep. bench-bot: run 4832 queued (config: 1xA100, batch-range 1-32, kv-cache ON).
maria (Marketing): Nice. Proposed narrative frames: 1) ease-of-onboarding + predictable latency, 2) unit economics (we'll use benchmark), 3) reliability & fallbacks. The blog will focus on frame 2.
jon (Product): Also add a "What this means" mini-table mapping p95 numbers to UX choices (e.g., <100ms: interactive UI; 100-300ms: near-real-time; >300ms: async). Helpful for engineers.
kevin (Eng): Note about wording: use "in our tests" and publish the exact test config. Provide a reproducible YAML snippet: ```yaml
model: open-llama-7b
precision: q4_0
batching: continuous
hardware: a100-80gb
prompt_set: synthetic-dialog-512
```
amy (Content): Good. For visuals I want: 1) line plot of p95 latency vs throughput, 2) grouped bar chart of $/1k tokens for each model/precision. I'll mock in Figma: https://figma.com/redwood/bench-v2 (will update).
sam (Data): Early numbers from the sweep: chat p95 = 86ms at 200 tps (A100 q4_0), cost = $0.29 / 1k tokens. completion p95 = 36ms at 500 tps, cost = $0.12 / 1k tokens. Full CSV & PNGs will be uploaded.
maria (Marketing): Those are solid. I'd like a comparative column labeled "typical managed endpoint" (publicly available numbers) but avoid naming competitors. Keep phrasing high-level.
jon (Product): Methodology mini-section: synthetic + open prompts, warmup policy, KV cache hit assumptions, how cost is calculated (cloud price + GPU amortization). We'll link to methodology appendix.
kevin (Eng): Add an operational reliability flow: primary: quantized high-throughput variant -> fallback: higher-precision model -> fallback: different region. Use it to justify graceful degradation claims.
amy (Content): I'll draft a 500-word narrative and three social blurbs (short, technical, and business). Need the chart PNGs by 3pm.
sam (Data): Uploading artifacts now: results_1767770001.csv, p95_vs_tps.png, cost_per_1k.png, metadata_1767770001.json. Drive: https://drive.google.com/redwood/bench/1767770001 (permissions set to anyone with link).
bench-bot: run 4832 completed. Artifacts generated.
maria (Marketing): Assignments: sam -> data + artifacts, kevin -> config & methodology blurb, jon -> product framing & CTA, amy -> write + social. Review at 4pm PT.
amy (Content): Drafts by 3:30pm. I'll prepare the two headline variants for A/B.
jon (Product): Also ensure we include an embeddable JSON metadata snippet so readers can reproduce the runs. Sam will add it right?
sam (Data): Yep, metadata JSON is in the drive.
maria (Marketing): If review goes well we'll publish the blog + webinar sign-up next Tuesday. Thanks team :tada:
